fixedRules: Current all-or-nothing bulk decisions and exact preview semantics must survive splitting.
A projection cannot authorize completion, uniqueness or temporal eligibility.
Permanent independence walls survive revocation/closure; service changes immediately invalidate stale acceptance.
No lifetime receipt dictionaries or invented lifetime caps. Technical attempts are process records, not domain events.
Generations fence commands within a stable conflict owner; they must not partition conflicting guards.

bulk_atomicity.instructions: For bulk_atomicity, choose the smallest authoritative design that preserves every stated fixed rule and source behavior. Weigh hidden concurrency and recovery decisions, not class count.

criteria.batch_admission_publication: AccessReviewDecisionBatch owns immutable selected item set and preview, canonical item holds, one durable batch publication fact. Item owners hold native decisions provisionally; composed reads and campaign completion require publication. No hold releases without exact fence.
criteria.partial_independent: Send one decision command to each item and expose each as it succeeds.
criteria.retain_whole_campaign: Keep all per-item state/history in campaign stream for bulk atomicity.

readiness_latest.instructions: For readiness_latest, choose the smallest authoritative design that preserves every stated fixed rule and source behavior. Weigh hidden concurrency and recovery decisions, not class count.

criteria.program_gate: ProgramReadiness per program owns latest assessment pointer and decision admission generation. Immutable assessment and gap-plan owners supply exact proofs; decision admission holds conflicting latest/plan changes until append; Type I approval is one per program.
criteria.assessment_only: Split assessments into streams; each decides from projected latest assessment and gap-plan directory.
criteria.keep_readiness_ledger: Keep all assessment snapshots and plan histories in one program stream.

claim_generation.instructions: For claim_generation, choose the smallest authoritative design that preserves every stated fixed rule and source behavior. Weigh hidden concurrency and recovery decisions, not class count.

criteria.stable_key_generation_state: Mailbox/name/source uniqueness claim stream uses stable conflict key only; generation, claimant and operation live in state and every release command compares them.
criteria.generation_in_key: Include generation/episode in the stream key so each attempt gets an independent claim.

import_publication_owner.instructions: For import_publication_owner, choose the smallest authoritative design that preserves every stated fixed rule and source behavior. Weigh hidden concurrency and recovery decisions, not class count.

criteria.batch_publication_source_admission: ApplicationImportSource serializes source admission/current source generation. ApplicationImportBatch owns immutable frozen complete manifest and its single all-target publication decision, which remains authoritative for old batches after later source batches. Release source only with exact batch completion/fence proof.
criteria.source_latest_only: Source stream owns only current batch publication state; target reads consult its current pointer.
criteria.projection_gate: Target row projection infers publication after all rows appear.

independence_epoch.instructions: For independence_epoch, choose the smallest authoritative design that preserves every stated fixed rule and source behavior. Weigh hidden concurrency and recovery decisions, not class count.

criteria.stable_service_epoch_barrier: ClientServiceIndependence per tenant/client serializes complete service-epoch changes with acceptance admission. ServiceEngagementIndependence per stable engagementId binds epoch in state; separate permanent PracticeIndependenceCommitment owners for canonical user and staff identity, acquired in canonical order. Personal decision records remain independent.
criteria.epoch_in_address: Per-service-epoch engagement streams and point-in-time source proofs suffice without shared conflict admission.
criteria.tenant_ledger: Keep all engagements/client service/staff history in one tenant stream.

retest_owner.instructions: For retest_owner, choose the smallest authoritative design that preserves every stated fixed rule and source behavior. Weigh hidden concurrency and recovery decisions, not class count.

criteria.same_type_new_evaluation: Use a new ControlEvaluation identity with predecessor evaluation/version proof for a retest; same state machine, independent lifecycle and stream.
criteria.distinct_retest_type: Add ControlEvaluationRetest type/stream while original ControlEvaluation owns non-retest evaluations.
criteria.reuse_prior_evaluation: Append every retest and prior results to the original evaluation stream.
